title: Impact of Al and Mn doping on the catalytic activity of magnetite spinel for sulfamethoxazole degradation: kinetics and toxicity assessment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00452G, Paper
B. Gokulakrishnan, G. Satishkumar
Redox-inactive aluminium-doped magnetite exhibited three times higher kinetics in decomposition of H2O2 to HO· for sulfamethoxazole degradation than redox-active manganese-doped magnetite.
